title: Samples: the boards' driver channels, run by run
source: /archive/datasets/bam_rig rack_2026-10-23, rack_2026-10-24, rack_2026-10-25: the rack's own run logs (moteus registers as logged), CAN 12, 13 and 14; written by gallery/examples/robotics-driver/source/build.py

fields.name: t
fields.description: seconds from the run's first logged row

fields.name: i_q_a
fields.title: q-axis current
fields.description: the board's i_q register, as logged

fields.name: v_bus_v
fields.title: Bus voltage
fields.description: the board's voltage register (0.5 V steps)

fields.name: temp_c
fields.title: Board temperature
fields.description: the board's temperature register: its FET / board temperature (sim2real's catalog: driver.board_temp), not the winding's

fields.name: fault
fields.title: Fault
fields.description: moteus's fault register: a limiter (96-105, why the output is being limited) or a fault (32-48); null when none
